schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship (Class IX & X)
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe as per domicile state
Studying in Govt or recognized school
Should not be receiving any other scholarship
One year of scholarship per class (no repeat-year benefit)
schemes.benefit_summary: ₹225–₹525/month scholarship + books grant (₹750–₹1000/year); extra for Divyangjan

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship (Class XI to Post-Graduation)
other_conditions: Passed Matriculation/Higher Secondary or equivalent
Must belong to Scheduled Tribe as per domicile state
Should not be receiving any other scholarship
Students in the 252 Top Class institutes should apply under National Scholarship (Top Class) instead, not here
schemes.benefit_summary: Fee reimbursement (group-wise) + stipend ₹230–₹1200/month depending on course group & hosteler/day-scholar status

schemes.name: National Scholarship (Top Class Education Scheme)
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe
Admission must be in one of the 252 MoTA-notified premier institutes (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs, etc.)
Not admitted via private Management quota
Students here are NOT eligible for Post-Matric Scholarship (avoid duplication)
schemes.benefit_summary: Full tuition/admission fee (₹2.5L/yr ceiling for private institutes) + ₹3000/month stipend + ₹5000/yr books + ₹45000 one-time computer grant

schemes.name: National Fellowship for ST Students (NFST) — MPhil/PhD
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe
Completed Post-Graduation/Master's degree with min 55% marks
Admission in UGC-recognized University/Institute of National Importance
750 fresh fellowships/year (priority slots: Divyangjan, PVTG, Female, then ST-Others)
No income criteria for this scheme
schemes.benefit_summary: ₹31,000–₹35,000/month stipend (Humanities) or similar (Science/Engg) + HRA + annual contingency ₹10,000–₹25,500

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS)
fields_of_study: Pure/Applied Science, Engineering, Technology, Mathematics (STEM) - 10 slots
other_conditions: Bachelor's level courses NOT covered — only PG and above
20 awards/year total (17 ST + 3 PVTG); 30% reserved for female candidates
Only one child per family eligible; one-time award per individual
Marks criteria waived if already admitted to QS World Top 1000 institute
schemes.benefit_summary: Full tuition + USD 15,400/yr maintenance (US) or equivalent + contingency + air passage + visa + insurance

eligibility_check_logic_notes.description: Suggested matching logic for the recommender engine
steps: 1. Filter by education level entered by user against each scheme's 'level' array
2. If income_ceiling_annual is set, compare user income; null means no income criteria (e.g., NFST)
3. If age_limit or age_limit_by_course is set, check against user's age as of July 1 of selection year
4. For NOS, additionally match study destination = Abroad and check min_marks_percent (waived if QS Top 1000 admit)
5. For Top Class Scholarship, check if user's institute is in the 252-list (institute_list.json) — this determines Top Class vs Post-Matric eligibility, and the two are mutually exclusive
6. Output status per scheme: 'Eligible' | 'Partially Eligible' (show first failing condition) | 'Not Eligible'
